# Handoff 05 - Claude: re-acceptance of codex-consult 0.2.0 after the fix wave

Date: 2026-09-24. Base commit: `6483ec4` + uncommitted (the full 0.2.0 change set, now including the fix wave).

## Question

Your HOLD (handoff 04) named four blockers and seven majors, F04-1..F04-11. All eleven were reproduced
against the pre-fix scripts, fixed, and covered by harness assertions. Can 0.2.0 now be accepted, or
what still blocks it? Report each F04 id in `prior_findings`.

## Delta since the last review

Follows: `handoffs/04-codex-acceptance-0.2.md` (HOLD).

- **F04-1** stores are written to a temp file in the same directory and replaced atomically
  (`File.Replace` / `File.Move`); an existing store that is empty, unparseable, not an object, or a
  `findings.json` without `findings` is refused as corruption, naming the file, in every mode incl.
  `-DryRun`, `-List` and `-Raw`. 12 hard kills mid-write: 0 corrupt stores.
- **F04-2 / F04-10** lock ownership is a HELD HANDLE: `.consult.lock` opened exclusively (Windows
  `FileShare.Read` so a refused contender can read the record; Unix `FileShare.None` = advisory
  flock) and kept open for the whole run; no reread-then-delete, no pid/start-time takeover. The
  record `{pid, start_time, nonce, host, task, started, n, nn, reply, child_pid, child_start_time,
  survivors}` is written before codex starts; `child_pid` after launch; `survivors` when a timeout
  kill could not stop the tree (file then kept). A leftover names a live codex pid -> refused until it
  exits; a foreign-host leftover with pids -> refused; otherwise reopened. 8 simultaneous contenders
  over a stale leftover -> exactly one owner.
- **F04-3** the lock record is the consultation reservation; a leftover reservation is skipped past
  ("recovered reservation n=.., nn=.."); numbering scans ledger `n`, `source.consult`,
  `reviewer_checks[].consult`, existing `F<NN>` ids and the reservation, in `-Raw` too; `-List` flags
  orphan reviewer checks as well as orphan findings.
- **F04-4** semantic validation knows the open prior findings: ACCEPT with a prior blocker reported
  `still-open` -> verdict '' + `validation_error`; `not-checked`/`unknown-id`/omitted -> verdict kept,
  `WARNING: ACCEPT with N unchecked prior blocker(s)`, ledger `unchecked_prior_blockers[]`; retained
  prior blockers rendered `(prior, still-open|not-checked)` under `### Blockers`, no duplicate records.
- **F04-5** `.reply.json` is copied byte for byte BEFORE parsing (write order now reply.json, md,
  findings, sessions); `line` bounded to 1..2147483647; normalization and semantics in try/catch ->
  validation error, never a throw; any bridge bug in parse/ingest becomes
  `bridge could not process the reply: ...` with no ingestion.
- **F04-6** verdict validated against the resolved purpose (acceptance/diff-review: ACCEPT|HOLD|REJECT;
  else ADVISE); mismatch -> validation error, findings kept.
- **F04-7** manifest lines carry a mode column from `git diff --raw HEAD` (`100644`, `100644>100755`,
  `=` tracked-unchanged-mode, `u` untracked with a fingerprint_note). Earlier `tree_sha256` values are
  therefore not comparable with new ones (pre-release, documented).
- **F04-8** every path-keyed map is an ordinal `Dictionary[string,string]`; verified on a
  case-sensitive folder (`fsutil setCaseSensitiveInfo`).
- **F04-9** brief and artifacts hashed under the lock before the run and again after; ledger
  `brief_sha256_after`, `brief_changed_during_review`, `artifacts[].sha256_after`,
  `artifacts_changed_during_review`; header WARNING on either drift.
- **F04-11** a failed raw-reply copy is a bridge failure (`failed: could not preserve the raw reply
  (...); original kept at <temp>`), exit 1, temp kept, no findings, no verdict, ledger entry appended.

## CURRENT invariants claimed

- All invariants from handoff 03 still hold (read-only default, exec options before the subcommand,
  stdin prompt, thread id from `thread.started`, `-DryRun` writes nothing, statuses moved only by
  `codex-findings.ps1`, `bridge_outcome` separate from `verdict`, UTF-8/LF outputs, ASCII scripts).
- Single writer per task directory is guaranteed by the held handle for the lifetime of the process;
  a crashed run's leftover is safe and self-recovering; only a live codex process blocks.
- No store is ever truncated in place; a kill mid-write leaves at most one stray `.<name>.<guid>.tmp`.
- The raw reply is durable before anything fallible runs on it.

## Changed files

Base commit `6483ec4`. `plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1` 1243 -> 1703 lines;
`codex-consult.ps1` 1038 -> 1113; `codex-findings.ps1` 271 -> 291; schema unchanged.

## Open findings

F04-1..F04-11, all `implemented` (fix attempted and covered by the implementer's harness; a
fresh-context verifier re-ran the harness and re-derived F04-1/2/4/5/6/7/8/9/11 with its own
fixtures - its report is recorded in `state.md` round 3 before this brief was sent). None `verified`
yet: that status is reserved for after your re-review plus the coordinator's own evidence.

## Evidence

- Implementer's regression on PowerShell 5.1: 46/46 fix assertions, 12/12 lock cases, all earlier
  items green (`harness-fixes.ps1`, `harness-lock2.ps1`, `verify-v1.ps1` against the pre-fix copy).
- Deviations chosen by the implementer and accepted: Windows share mode `Read` not `None`;
  `child_start_time` added; refused contenders re-read for ~1 s and name a pid only if alive;
  `codex-findings -Status` puts a found reservation back; `unknown-id` counts as not-checked;
  retained prior blockers rendered for every verdict.
- Not verified, still: PowerShell 7 / Unix paths (`File.Move` overwrite, flock, delete-before-close,
  `pgrep` tree kill); a real timeout with unkillable survivors in the full script (lock tests cover
  the branch); cross-host shares (out of scope).

## Questions

- **Q1.** Re-read the changed regions (`Enter-TaskLock`/`Exit-TaskLock`, `Write-JsonFile`,
  `Get-RevisionInfo`, `Test-StructuredReply`, and `codex-consult.ps1` from the run section down).
  For each F04 id: fixed, still-open, or not-checked - with the concrete gap if still-open.
- **Q2.** Does the held-handle lock introduce a new failure mode the old scheme did not have
  (e.g. a reader holding `FileShare.Read` on Windows, antivirus scanners, `-List` during a run)?
- **Q3.** Verdict on 0.2.0 now: ACCEPT, HOLD or REJECT, with blockers, unproven scenarios and the
  observable first-run checklist for this consultation (it runs as `resume` of your HOLD thread,
  with the eleven ids fed back as prior findings).

Answer by number. Keep it under 800 words.

# Task: bridge-0.2-2026-09-23 - implement ROADMAP R1-R6 and TECH_DEBT T1-T4 as codex-consult 0.2.0

Base commit: `6483ec4`. Coordinator: Claude Code. Reviewer: Codex (thread `01a0cff8-4583-7110-8730-5fda5333d388`, new, this repository only).

## Round 1 - framing (design review before implementation)

- `handoffs/01-claude-design-0.2.md` (the design) -> `handoffs/02-codex-design-0.2.md`: **HOLD the design as written**;
  scope coherent, but revision binding, locking and crash recovery need explicit contracts first.

### Adopted (all go into 0.2.0)

- Q1 schema: `evidence` becomes an array of `{kind, reference, observation}` (what was already done), `verification`
  stays prospective; `locations[]` of `{path, line|null}` instead of a `"path:line"` string; `schema_version`;
  local validation of shape and semantics (ACCEPT with a blocker finding = invalid verdict); an invalid reply keeps
  the raw text, records the validation error, gives NO verdict and ingests NO findings; the raw response is stored
  byte for byte; the four R4 blocks are the LAST sections of the reply file.
- Q2 identity: reviewer verdicts on prior findings are evidence only; `supersedes` relationship for splits/merges/
  corrected claims; explicit reopen; `verified` requires `-Evidence`, not just a note; the trigger and the
  verification criterion are fed back with the claim; ids listed but not reported -> `not-checked`; unknown ids
  create nothing; ids allocated under the lock; the `NN-` filename matcher fixed for handoff >= 100.
- Q3 revision binding: a deterministic manifest (status, blob hash, PATH per entry of `git status -uall`) hashed
  as `tree_sha256`, so a rename is distinguishable; the collab directory excluded; the brief hashed separately;
  omissions (submodules, ignored files, no git) recorded in `fingerprint_note`; fingerprint taken before AND after
  the review, a difference is flagged.
- Q4 defaults: structured on, `-Raw` opt-out; core-contract narrowed to the interfaces and state machines named in
  the brief; the word cap applies to prose only; R5 rework measure = coordinator-recorded finding statuses joined
  to the consultation that produced them (`codex-findings.ps1 -Stats`); absent usage fields stay null.
- Q5 lock: atomic create (`FileMode.CreateNew`), owner nonce + process start time (PID reuse), release only our
  own lock, acquire before reading the ledger or allocating names, both scripts participate; timeout kills the
  process TREE; no automatic cross-host takeover.
- Q6: the acceptance checklist becomes the test plan for this release (failure paths never produce a verdict;
  concurrency; singleton arrays; handoff 100+; dry-run writes nothing; existing ledgers still load).

### Rejected or deferred (with reason)

- Cross-host lock takeover: CUT from 0.2.0 (no lease/fencing); a foreign-host lock is refused and must be removed
  by a human who knows the owner is dead.
- Thread-scoped exclusion (one thread resumed from two task directories): documented as a constraint, not enforced.
- Immutable snapshot of the reviewed tree: deferred; the before/after fingerprint flags a changed tree instead.
- A full commit/recovery journal: partial - fixed write order (reply, reply.json, findings.json, sessions.json as
  the commit point) plus orphan detection in `-List`; a crash leaves nothing overwritten.
- Binding quoted test results to their own tested revision: the status-change record carries the fingerprint of
  the moment it is made; the coordinator names the tested revision in `-Evidence`. No separate field yet.

## Round 2 - acceptance (first live run of the structured path)

  IS enforced server-side); the Markdown ends with Findings, Prior findings, Verdict, Blockers, Unproven, First-run
  checklist; `tree_changed_during_review=true` was correctly raised (the docs worker edited README during the
  review); `brief_sha256` recorded; usage copied from `turn.completed`; lock removed; `-List` shows 11 open, 0

- Reviewer's findings, all adopted as a fix wave before release (design choices are the coordinator's):

461: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- lock + run
462: #
463: # Everything from here to the end runs while <task>/.consult.lock is HELD OPEN (not in
464: # -DryRun, which writes nothing at all): the lock is taken BEFORE sessions.json and
465: # findings.json are read and before the consult number n and the handoff number NN
466: # are allocated, and released in `finally` (an `exit` inside `try` still runs it).
467: # The lock file doubles as the run's reservation: n, nn and the planned reply path
468: # are written into it before codex starts, the codex pid right after. If this
469: # process dies, the OS drops the handle and the record stays: the next run numbers
470: # past that reservation and refuses while the recorded codex process still lives.
471: # After a timeout kill that could not stop the whole codex tree, the survivors are
472: # recorded and the file is left in place for the same reason.
473: #
474: # Write order after the run:
475: #   1. handoffs/NN-codex-<slug>.reply.json  byte-for-byte copy of Codex's last message,
476: #                                           BEFORE any parsing (a failed copy is a
477: #                                           bridge failure; the temp original is kept)
478: #   2. handoffs/NN-codex-<slug>.md          header + verbatim reply (+ rendered section)
479: #   3. findings.json                        new findings, reviewer checks
480: #   4. sessions.json                        the ledger entry - the commit point
481: # Both JSON stores are replaced atomically (temp file + replace), and an existing
482: # store that is empty or unparseable is refused as corruption. A crash between 3 and
483: # 4 leaves findings or reviewer checks whose consult has no ledger entry;
484: # `codex-findings.ps1 -List` flags them as ORPHAN, and numbering never reuses a
485: # number that any finding, reviewer check, handoff file or reservation names.
486: 
487: $lock = $null
488: $keepLock = $false
489: $keepLastMsg = $false
490: if (-not $DryRun) {
491:     [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($handoffsDir)
492:     $lock = Enter-TaskLock -TaskDir $taskDir -Task $Task
493:     if (-not $lock.Acquired) { Stop-WithError $lock.Message }
494: }
495: 
496: try {
497:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- ledgers
498: 
499:     $sessions = Read-JsonStore -Path $sessionsPath
500:     if ($null -eq $sessions) {
501:         $sessions = [pscustomobject]@{
502:             task_id = $Task
503:             cwd     = $repoRoot
504:             codex   = [pscustomobject]@{
505:                 tool     = $codexVersion
506:                 consults = [object[]]@()
507:             }
508:         }
509:         if (-not $DryRun) { Write-JsonFile -Path $sessionsPath -Object $sessions }
510:     }
511:     if (-not $sessions.PSObject.Properties['codex']) {
512:         $sessions | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'codex' -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{ tool = $codexVersion; consults = [object[]]@() })
513:     }
514:     if (-not $sessions.codex.PSObject.Properties['consults']) {
515:         $sessions.codex | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'consults' -NotePropertyValue ([object[]]@())
516:     }
517:     $sessions.codex.tool = $codexVersion
518: 
519:     # findings.json is read in both modes - numbering must see every finding and
520:     # reviewer check - but only structured mode lists open findings and ingests.
521:     $findingsStore = Read-FindingsFile -Path $findingsPath -Task $Task
522:     $openFindings = @()
523:     if (-not $Raw) {
524:         $openFindings = @($findingsStore.findings | Where-Object { $script:OpenStatuses -contains [string](Get-PropertyValue $_ 'status' '') })
525:     }
526:     $listedIds = [string[]]@($openFindings | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.id })
527:     # { id; severity; status } of the listed prior findings, for verdict validation.
528:     $priorInfo = @($openFindings | ForEach-Object {
529:             [pscustomobject]@{ id = [string]$_.id; severity = [string](Get-PropertyValue $_ 'severity' ''); status = [string](Get-PropertyValue $_ 'status' '') }
530:         })
531: 
532:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- mode + thread
533: 
534:     # Older ledger entries (0.1: `outcome`, no `purpose`, ...) are left untouched; only
535:     # `thread` is read from them.
536:     $consults = @($sessions.codex.consults | Where-Object { $_ })
537:     $knownThread = ''
538:     if ($Thread) {
539:         $knownThread = $Thread.Trim()
540:     } else {
541:         for ($i = $consults.Count - 1; $i -ge 0; $i--) {
542:             $c = $consults[$i]
543:             if ($c.PSObject.Properties['thread'] -and $c.thread) { $knownThread = [string]$c.thread; break }
544:         }
545:     }
546: 
547:     if (-not $Mode) {
548:         if ($knownThread) { $Mode = 'fork' } else { $Mode = 'new' }
549:     }
550:     if ($Mode -ne 'new' -and -not $knownThread) {
551:         Stop-WithError "-Mode $Mode needs a thread: pass -Thread <uuid>, or make sure '$sessionsPath' has codex.consults[].thread."
552:     }
553:     $parentThread = ''
554:     if ($Mode -ne 'new') { $parentThread = $knownThread }
555: 
556:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- numbering
557: 
558:     # A dry run holds no lock; it only peeks at a leftover reservation.
559:     $leftover = $null
560:     if ($lock) { $leftover = $lock.Leftover } else { $leftover = Read-LockContent -Path $lockPath }
561:     $numbers = Get-NextNumbers -Consults $consults -Store $findingsStore -HandoffsDir $handoffsDir -Leftover $leftover
562:     $consultN = $numbers.N
563:     $nn = $numbers.Nn
564:     $recoveredLine = ''
565:     if ($numbers.Recovered) {
566:         if ($DryRun) {
567:             # A dry run cannot tell a running consultation's reservation from an
568:             # interrupted one's (it does not take the lock).
569:             $recoveredLine = "the lock holds reservation n=$($numbers.RecoveredN), nn=$($numbers.RecoveredNn) (a running or interrupted consultation); numbering continues past it."
570:         } else {
571:             $recoveredLine = "recovered reservation n=$($numbers.RecoveredN), nn=$($numbers.RecoveredNn) (an earlier run stopped before its ledger entry); numbering continues past it."
572:             Write-Host "codex-consult: $recoveredLine" -ForegroundColor Yellow
573:         }
574:     }
575:     # NB: PowerShell variable names are case-insensitive - never call these $replyName,
576:     # that would silently clobber the -ReplyName parameter.
577:     $replyFileName = "$nn-codex-$ReplyName.md"
578:     $eventsFileName = "$nn-codex-$ReplyName.events.jsonl"
579:     $replyJsonFileName = "$nn-codex-$ReplyName.reply.json"
580:     $replyPath = Join-Path $handoffsDir $replyFileName
581:     $eventsPath = Join-Path $handoffsDir $eventsFileName
582:     $replyJsonPath = Join-Path $handoffsDir $replyJsonFileName
583:     $replyRel = "handoffs/$replyFileName"
584:     $eventsRel = "handoffs/$eventsFileName"
585:     $replyJsonPlanned = ''
586:     if (-not $Raw) { $replyJsonPlanned = "handoffs/$replyJsonFileName" }
587:     if ($lock) { Update-TaskLock -Lock $lock -Fields @{ n = $consultN; nn = $nn; reply = $replyRel } }
588: 
589:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- prompt
670:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- bindings
671: 
672:     # Hashed now, under the lock (and again after the run): the brief and the artifacts
673:     # live outside the tree fingerprint (collab dir / ignored or external files).
674:     $briefSha = ''
675:     if ($briefPath) { $briefSha = Get-FileSha256OrMissing -Path $briefPath }
676:     $artifactHashes = @(Get-ArtifactHashes -Artifacts $artifactItems)
677:     # Fingerprint of the tree under review, before the run (and again after it).
678:     $revBefore = Get-RevisionInfo -Root $repoRoot -CollabRoot $collabRoot
679: 
680:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- dry run
777:     Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $promptPath -Text $promptText
778: 
779:     $startedAt = Get-Date
780:     $stopwatch = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
781:     $exitCode = -1
782:     $bridgeOutcome = ''
783:     $argStr = (($argv | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-ProcArg $_ }) -join ' ')
784: 
785:     try {
786:         $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $codexExePath -ArgumentList $argStr `
787:             -WorkingDirectory $repoRoot -NoNewWindow -PassThru `
788:             -RedirectStandardOutput $eventsPath `
789:             -RedirectStandardError $stderrPath `
790:             -RedirectStandardInput $promptPath
791:         # PS 5.1: touching .Handle before the process exits caches it, otherwise
792:         # .ExitCode comes back empty on a -PassThru process.
793:         if ($script:LegacyPS) { try { $null = $proc.Handle } catch { } }
794:         # Record the codex launcher in the lock: if this process dies, the next run
795:         # refuses while that child is still alive.
796:         try { Update-TaskLock -Lock $lock -Fields @{ child_pid = $proc.Id; child_start_time = [string](Get-ProcessStartIso -ProcessId $proc.Id) } } catch { }
797:         $finished = $proc.WaitForExit($TimeoutSec * 1000)
798:         if (-not $finished) {
799:             # The launcher is usually a shim (codex.cmd -> node -> codex.exe): kill
800:             # the whole tree, or the real codex keeps running after we give up.
801:             $survivors = Stop-ProcessTree -Process $proc   # [int[]]; never wrap in @(): that nests the array
802:             $bridgeOutcome = "failed: timeout after $TimeoutSec s (process tree killed)"
803:             if ($survivors.Count -gt 0) {
804:                 $bridgeOutcome = "failed: timeout after $TimeoutSec s (process tree killed; $($survivors.Count) processes survived: pid $($survivors -join ', '); the task lock stays until they exit)"
805:                 # Keep the lock file with the survivors in it: the next run refuses
806:                 # while any of them lives.
807:                 try { Update-TaskLock -Lock $lock -Fields @{ survivors = [object[]]$survivors } } catch { }
808:                 $keepLock = $true
809:             }
810:         } else {
811:             $exitCode = $proc.ExitCode
812:         }
813:     } catch {
814:         $bridgeOutcome = "failed: could not start codex - $($_.Exception.Message)"
815:     }
816:     $stopwatch.Stop()
817:     $wallSeconds = [math]::Round($stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 1)
818: 
819:     $revAfter = Get-RevisionInfo -Root $repoRoot -CollabRoot $collabRoot
820:     $treeChanged = ($revBefore.tree_sha256 -ne $revAfter.tree_sha256)
821:     $briefShaAfter = ''
822:     if ($briefPath) { $briefShaAfter = Get-FileSha256OrMissing -Path $briefPath }
823:     $briefChanged = ($briefSha -ne $briefShaAfter)
824:     $artifactsFinal = @($artifactHashes | ForEach-Object {
825:             $item = $_
826:             $full = @($artifactItems | Where-Object { $_.path -eq $item.path } | Select-Object -First 1)[0].full
827:             [pscustomobject]@{ path = $item.path; sha256 = $item.sha256; sha256_after = (Get-FileSha256OrMissing -Path $full) }
828:         })
829:     $changedArtifacts = @($artifactsFinal | Where-Object { $_.sha256 -ne $_.sha256_after } | ForEach-Object { $_.path })
830:     $artifactsChanged = ($changedArtifacts.Count -gt 0)
831: 
832:     $stderrText = Read-SharedText -Path $stderrPath
833:     $rawReply = (Read-SharedText -Path $lastMsgPath).Trim()
834: 
835:     # thread id - never let a parse/IO problem here swallow the sessions.json record
836:     $threadId = ''
837:     $threadSource = 'unknown'
838:     try {
839:         $threadId = Get-ThreadIdFromEvents -Path $eventsPath
840:         if ($threadId) {
841:             $threadSource = 'events'
842:         } else {
843:             $threadId = Get-ThreadIdFromRollout -StartedAt $startedAt
844:             if ($threadId) { $threadSource = 'rollout' }
845:         }
846:     } catch {
847:         $threadId = ''
848:         $threadSource = 'unknown'
849:     }
850: 
851:     $eventError = ''
852:     try { $eventError = Get-ErrorFromEvents -Path $eventsPath } catch { $eventError = '' }
853:     $usage = $null
854:     try { $usage = Get-UsageFromEvents -Path $eventsPath } catch { $usage = $null }
855: 
856:     if (-not $bridgeOutcome) {
857:         if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
858:             $detail = $eventError
859:             if (-not $detail -and $stderrText) {
860:                 $detail = ($stderrText.Trim() -split "`r?`n" | Select-Object -Last 1)
861:             }
862:             $tail = ''
863:             if ($detail) { $tail = ' - ' + $detail }
864:             $bridgeOutcome = "failed: codex exit $exitCode$tail"
865:         } elseif (-not $rawReply) {
866:             $detail = ''
867:             if ($eventError) { $detail = ' - ' + $eventError }
868:             $bridgeOutcome = "failed: empty reply$detail"
869:         } else {
870:             $bridgeOutcome = 'usable reply'
871:         }
872:     }
873: 
874:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- 1. reply.json
875: 
876:     # The first write after the run, before anything parses the reply: Codex's last
877:     # message copied BYTE FOR BYTE (never re-serialized, never trimmed). If it cannot
878:     # be preserved, the run is a bridge failure and the temp original is kept.
879:     $replyJsonRel = ''
880:     if (-not $Raw -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lastMsgPath -PathType Leaf)) {
881:         $copyError = ''
882:         for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 6; $attempt++) {
883:             try {
884:                 [IO.File]::Copy($lastMsgPath, $replyJsonPath, $true)
885:                 $copyError = ''
886:                 break
887:             } catch {
888:                 $copyError = ConvertTo-OneLine $_.Exception.Message
889:                 Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
890:             }
891:         }
892:         if ($copyError) {
893:             $keepLastMsg = $true
894:             $note = "could not preserve the raw reply ($copyError); original kept at $lastMsgPath"
895:             if ($bridgeOutcome -eq 'usable reply') { $bridgeOutcome = "failed: $note" }
896:             else { $bridgeOutcome += "; $note" }
897:         } else {
898:             $replyJsonRel = $replyJsonPlanned
899:         }
900:     }
901: 
902:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- structured reply
903: 
904:     # A reply that is not valid JSON or breaks the schema is NOT a bridge failure: the
905:     # raw text is kept as the reply, but there is no verdict and no finding is recorded.
906:     # A structurally valid reply whose verdict does not fit the purpose or contradicts
907:     # a blocker keeps its findings but records no verdict.
908:     $structured = $false
909:     $parse = $null
910:     $ingest = $null
911:     $validationError = ''
912:     $verdict = ''
913:     $verdictReason = ''
914:     $replyBody = $rawReply
915:     $counts = [pscustomobject]@{ blocker = 0; major = 0; minor = 0; note = 0 }
916:     $findingIds = @()
917:     $priorForLedger = @()
918:     $uncheckedPrior = @()
919:     if (-not $Raw -and $bridgeOutcome -eq 'usable reply') {
920:         try {
921:             $parse = ConvertFrom-StructuredReply -Text $rawReply -Purpose $Purpose -PriorFindings $priorInfo
922:             $validationError = $parse.ValidationError
923:             if ($parse.Valid) {
924:                 $ingest = Add-ReplyFindings -Store $findingsStore -Reply $parse.Reply -Nn $nn -ConsultN $consultN `
925:                     -ReplyRel $replyRel -ThreadId $threadId -BaseCommit $revBefore.base_commit `
926:                     -TreeSha256 $revBefore.tree_sha256 -ListedIds $listedIds
927:                 $structured = $true
928:                 $replyBody = $parse.Reply.reply_markdown
929:                 $verdict = $parse.Verdict
930:                 if (-not $parse.VerdictInvalid) { $verdictReason = $parse.Reply.verdict_reason }
931:                 $counts = $ingest.Counts
932:                 $findingIds = @($ingest.NewIds)
933:                 $priorForLedger = @($ingest.PriorEntries | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ id = $_.id; status = $_.status } })
934:                 $uncheckedPrior = @($parse.UncheckedPriorBlockers)
935:             }
936:         } catch {
937:             # Never lose the reply over a bridge bug: record it as unprocessable.
938:             $structured = $false
939:             $ingest = $null
940:             $verdict = ''
941:             $verdictReason = ''
942:             $replyBody = $rawReply
943:             $validationError = "bridge could not process the reply: $(ConvertTo-OneLine $_.Exception.Message)"
944:             $parse = [pscustomobject]@{ Valid = $false; ValidationError = $validationError; Reply = $null; UncheckedPriorBlockers = @() }
945:         }
1004:     Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $replyPath -Text $replyText
1005: 
1006:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- 3. findings.json
1007: 
1008:     if ($ingest -and $ingest.Changed) {
1009:         Write-FindingsFile -Path $findingsPath -Store $findingsStore
1010:     }
1011: 
1012:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- 4. sessions.json
1013: 
1014:     $entry = [pscustomobject]@{
1015:         n                               = $consultN
1016:         when                            = (Get-IsoTimestamp $startedAt)
1017:         purpose                         = $Purpose
1018:         parent_thread                   = $parentThread
1019:         thread                          = $threadId
1020:         thread_source                   = $threadSource
1021:         mode                            = $Mode
1022:         command                         = $commandStr
1023:         brief                           = $briefRef
1024:         prompt_chars                    = $promptText.Length
1025:         reply                           = $replyRel
1026:         reply_json                      = $replyJsonRel
1027:         events                          = $eventsRel
1028:         model                           = $modelLabel
1029:         effort                          = $effortResolved
1030:         max_words                       = $maxWordsResolved
1031:         sandbox                         = $Sandbox
1032:         structured                      = $structured
1033:         schema                          = $(if ($Raw) { '' } else { 'consult-reply v1' })
1034:         validation_error                = $validationError
1035:         base_commit                     = $revBefore.base_commit
1036:         reviewed_revision               = $revBefore.reviewed_revision
1037:         tree_sha256                     = $revBefore.tree_sha256
1038:         tree_sha256_after               = $revAfter.tree_sha256
1039:         tree_changed_during_review      = $treeChanged
1040:         changed_files                   = $revBefore.changed_files
1041:         brief_sha256                    = $briefSha
1042:         brief_sha256_after              = $briefShaAfter
1043:         brief_changed_during_review     = $briefChanged
1044:         fingerprint_note                = $revBefore.fingerprint_note
1045:         artifacts                       = [object[]]$artifactsFinal
1046:         artifacts_changed_during_review = $artifactsChanged
1047:         bridge_outcome                  = $bridgeOutcome
1048:         verdict                         = $verdict
1049:         verdict_reason                  = $verdictReason
1050:         findings                        = [pscustomobject]@{ blocker = $counts.blocker; major = $counts.major; minor = $counts.minor; note = $counts.note }
1051:         finding_ids                     = [object[]]$findingIds
1052:         prior_findings                  = [object[]]$priorForLedger
1053:         unchecked_prior_blockers        = [object[]]$uncheckedPrior
1054:         usage                           = $usage
1055:         wall_seconds                    = $wallSeconds
1056:     }
1057:     $newConsults = @()
1058:     $newConsults += $consults
1059:     $newConsults += $entry
1060:     $sessions.codex.consults = [object[]]$newConsults
1061:     Write-JsonFile -Path $sessionsPath -Object $sessions
1062: 
1063:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------------- output
1064: 
1065:     if ($bridgeOutcome -ne 'usable reply') {
1066:         Write-Host "codex-consult: $bridgeOutcome (wall $wallSeconds s)" -ForegroundColor Red
1067:         foreach ($d in $driftLines) { Write-Host $d -ForegroundColor Yellow }
1068:         Write-Host "reply file : $replyPath"
1069:         if ($replyJsonRel) { Write-Host "reply json : $replyJsonPath" }
1070:         Write-Host "events file: $eventsPath"
1071:         if ($stderrText.Trim()) {
1072:             Write-Host "--- codex stderr (tail) ---"
1073:             Write-Host (($stderrText.Trim() -split "`r?`n" | Select-Object -Last 20) -join "`n")
1074:         }
1075:         exit 1
1076:     }
1077: 
1078:     Write-Host "codex-consult: $bridgeOutcome - mode $Mode, thread $threadId (source: $threadSource), wall $wallSeconds s"
1079:     if ($parse) {
1080:         if ($structured) {
1081:             if ($parse.VerdictInvalid) { Write-Host "verdict    : (invalid: $validationError)" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
1082:             else { Write-Host "verdict    : $verdict - $(ConvertTo-OneLine $verdictReason)" }
1083:             if ($verdictWarning) { Write-Host $verdictWarning -ForegroundColor Yellow }
1084:             if ($findingIds.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host "findings   : $(Format-SeverityCounts $counts) -> $(Format-IdRange $findingIds) in findings.json" }
1085:             else { Write-Host "findings   : none" }
1086:             if (@($ingest.PriorEntries).Count -gt 0) {
1087:                 Write-Host ("prior      : " + ((@($ingest.PriorEntries) | ForEach-Object { "$($_.id) $($_.status)" }) -join ', '))
1088:             }
1089:             if (@($ingest.UnknownIds).Count -gt 0) {
1090:                 Write-Host "unknown ids: $(@($ingest.UnknownIds) -join ', ') (not in findings.json; ignored)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
1091:             }
1092:             if (@($ingest.UnknownSupersedes).Count -gt 0) {
1093:                 Write-Host "supersedes : $(@($ingest.UnknownSupersedes) -join ', ') not in findings.json (kept on the new finding only)" -ForegroundColor Yellow
1094:             }
1095:         } else {
1096:             Write-Host "structured : INVALID ($validationError) - raw text kept; no findings recorded" -ForegroundColor Yellow
1097:         }
1098:     }
1099:     foreach ($d in $driftLines) { Write-Host $d -ForegroundColor Yellow }
1100:     Write-Host "reply file : $replyPath"
1101:     if ($replyJsonRel) { Write-Host "reply json : $replyJsonPath" }
1102:     Write-Host "events file: $eventsPath"
1103:     Write-Host ""
1104:     Write-Host $replyBody
1105:     if ($section) {
1106:         Write-Host ""
1107:         Write-Host $section
1108:     }
1109:     exit 0
1110: } finally {
1111:     foreach ($tmp in @($promptPath, $stderrPath)) {
1112:         if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1113:     }
1114:     if (-not $keepLastMsg -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lastMsgPath)) {
1115:         Remove-Item -LiteralPath $lastMsgPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1116:     }
1117:     Exit-TaskLock -Lock $lock -Keep:$keepLock
1118: }
1119:

item.text: The direct fixes for store replacement, validation, and fingerprint lookup are present. The remaining concern is crash recovery: lock acquisition overwrites the previous reservation and child-process record before checking them, and recording the newly launched child is still best-effort. I’m checking those boundaries separately from normal lock contention.
